title: The House of Mirth
author: Edith Wharton
summary: Lily Bart, a beautiful woman in New York high society around 1900, needs a wealthy husband to keep her place. Her own scruples and the gossip of others steadily undo her chances.
readIf: you like sharp novels of manners that criticise social class and the limits placed on women.
skipIf: you want an uplifting story or a heroine who gets a fair break.
